newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DISCIPLINARY SITUATION IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DISCIPLINARY SITUATION IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.

text.p: The following list shows players with yellow and red cards going into this week's European club competition semifinal second-leg matches (first-leg score in parentheses):
European Cup
Juventus v Ajax Amsterdam (2-1)
Juventus - Suspended: Vladimir Jugovic
Yellow cards: Alen Boksic, Angelo Peruzzi, Sergio Porrini, Ciro Ferrara, Moreno Torricelli, Vladimir Jugovic, Mark Iuliano, Alessio Tacchinardi, Angelo Di Livio
Ajax - Suspended: none
Yellow cards: Mario Melchiot, Roderick Turpijn, Menno Willems, Tijani Babangida, Ronald de Boer, Nordin Wooter
Manchester United v Borussia Dortmund (0-1)
Manchester United - Suspended: Roy Keane
Yellow cards: Gary Neville, Jordi Cruyff, David Beckham, Eric Cantona, Ole Solskjaer, Denis Irwin, Gary Pallister Borussia Dortmund - Suspended: none
Yellow cards: Julio Cesar, Wolfgang Feiersinger, Heiko Herrlich, Andreas Moeller, Martin Kree, Paolo Sousa, Jorg Heinrich, Lars Ricken
UEFA Cup
Schalke v Tenerife (0-1)
Schalke - Suspended: none
Yellow cards: Oliver Held, Youri Mulder, Jens Lehmann, Olaf Thon, Yves Eigenrauch, Johan de Kock, Thomas Linke, Andreas Muller, Ingo Anderbrugge, Jiri Nemec
Tenerife - Suspended: Antonio Robaina, Marcelo Ojeda, Juan Castano, Angel Vivar Dorado
Yellow cards: Jose Martin Suarez, Julio Gento Llorente, Cesar Gomez del Rey, Meho Kodro, Slavisa Jokanovic, Sizwe Motaung.
Monaco v Internazionale (1-3)
Monaco - Suspended: Ali Benarbia, Gilles Grimandi
Yellow cards: Enzo Scifo, Thierry Henry, Martin Djetou, Sylvain Legwinski, Llaurent Viaud, Fabien Barthez, Ali Benarbia, Patrick Blondeau

Internazionale - Suspended: Almando Pistone, Ivan Zamorano Yellow cards: Maurizio Ganz, Javier Zanetti, Fabio Galante, Almando Pistone, Giuseppe Bergomi, Ivan Zamorano, Salvatore Fresi, Jocelyn Angloma, Yuri Djorkaeff.
European Cup Winners' Cup
Fiorentina v Barcelona (1-1)

Fiorentina: Suspended: Gabriel Batistuta, Giulio Falcone Yellow cards: Giovanni Piacentini, Francesco Baiano, Gabriel Batistuta, Pasquale Padalino, Luis Oliveira, Vittorio Pusceddu, Lorenzo Amoroso, Giulio Falcone, Michele Serena
Barcelona: Suspended: Gheorghe Popescu
Yellow cards: Amor, Hristo Stoichkov, Pizzi, Antuna Fernandez, Jose Sala Guardiola, Laurent Blanc, Alberto Ferrer.
Liverpool v Paris St Germain (0-3)
Liverpool: Suspended: Steve Harkness
Yellow cards: Stig Inge Bjornebye, Neil Ruddock Paris St Germain: Suspended: none
Yellow cards: Romeo Calenda, Vincent Guerin, Benoit Cauet, Vincent Fernandez, Alain Roche, Rai, Didier Domi, Bernard Lama, Leonardo.
